name: Camping Maria
beschreibung: The **Camping Maria** campsite is located in the **Ötztal** valley in **Tyrol**, near the village of **Längenfeld**. The area is defined by a stunning **mountain panorama**, featuring **hiking trails** and a **ski resort**. The site offers a **peaceful atmosphere** and is perfect for **families**. Facilities include **sanitary amenities**, **electrical hookups**, and a **small shop**. A **restaurant** serving regional cuisine is also available. Guests should bring their own **camping equipment**; **motorhomes** are welcome. The surrounding nature invites you to take **walks** and go on **mountain hikes**. The **season** runs from May to October.
